summary: Recommends avoiding configuration-dependent content, such as relying on ansible.cfg as the project root, and instead using magic variables like playbook_dir or role_name for relative paths.
questions: How do I reference files relative to my playbook without depending on ansible.cfg location?
What variables give me the playbook or role path?
How do I make my Ansible project portable?

answer_card.title: Avoid configuration-dependent paths
answer_card.answer_md: Don't treat `ansible.cfg` as your project root. Use magic variables such as `playbook_dir` or `role_name` to build paths relative to known locations in your project. This keeps content reusable and easy to share.
